generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder in his name should have satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor at least one similar work related to repair / rewinding works of 55kw and above Traction AC / Traction DC motors or generators in any power generating station OR processing industry OR reputed organization of any Central OR State Govt. PSUs OR Public utility, costing not less than Rs.11.78 Lakhs (exclusive of GST) in any one of the previous five years period. Work order and Work done certificates shall be enclosed as a documentary proof issued by the competent authority. Work done of previous years will be given 10 percent of simple weightage per year to bring them to current year price level.

The intending bidder in his name should have in the preceding five years period, achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs.23.56 Lakhs. Copy of turnover certificate from competent Auditor Auditors report along with the Balance Sheets and Profit and Loss statements shall be enclosed as a documentary proof. Financial Turnover of previous years will be given 10 percent of simple weightage per year to bring them to current year price level.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Rewinding / restoration / repair works of locomotive traction generator and traction motors at BTPS

itemList.description: Dismantling, inspection and re-assembling of traction generator : Complete dismantling of traction generator along with all attachments and inspection of the traction generator with relevant testing and submitting reports. Complete re-assembling of traction generator as it is in original condition. Transportation from BTPS to workshop To & FRO is under contractor's scope

Dismantling, inspection and re-assembling of traction motor : Complete dismantling of traction motor along with pinion and all associated attachments and inspection of the traction motor with relevant testing and submitting reports. Complete re-assembling of traction motor as it is in original condition. Transportation from BTPS to workshop To & FRO is under contractor's scope.
Complete commutator segments correction with armature winding reconnection, re-insulation and complete commutator restoration works of Traction Motor / Traction Generator

Supply and fixing of complete new commutator for traction generator / traction motor as per OEM with armature winding reconnection, re-insulation and complete commutator works for Traction Motor / Traction Generator
Bracing of punctured / damaged winding / cable connections in traction generator / traction motor including OEM recommended conductor and insulation, baking, varnishing, curing etc.

Complete Rewinding of inter pole with OEM recommended grade conductor and insulation with re-connection with existing poles, baking, varnishing, curing etc. complete as per standards for Traction Motor / Traction Generator

Complete Rewinding of main pole with OEM recommended grade conductor and insulation with re-connection with existing poles, baking, varnishing, curing etc. complete as per standards for Traction Motor / Traction Generator
Re-insulation of complete field winding including inter-poles and main poles complete with all re-fixing, re-connections, baking, varnishing, curing etc. complete as per standards
Supply & fixing of interpole and main pole bolts (non magnetic) as per OEM
Supply and fixing of complete new carbon brush holder assembly in traction motor/traction generator.
Re-insulation of complete armature with re-fixing, re-connections, baking, varnishing, curing etc. complete as per standards.

Complete rewinding of Traction Generator armature with OEM recommended grade conductor and insulation, re-fixing, re-connections, baking, varnishing, curing etc. complete armature restoration works as per standards.

Complete rewinding of Traction Motor armature with OEM recommended grade conductor and insulation, re-fixing, re-connections, baking, varnishing, curing etc. complete armature restoration works as per standards.

Replacement of bearings: Replacement of DE / NDE bearing of traction motor / traction generator, correction of bearing steps on shaft & housing, balancing of armature (bearings will be supplied by KPCL)
Replacement and restoration of damaged / burnt main power cable leads connection with supply of appropriate copper lugs as per technical specifications
